# Verifies reactive for-loop emission: items mutates → DOM list rebuilds
# via __renderSlot. Tests Plan A's structural reactivity under the
# htmlTranslator path that Task 9 wired.
#
# Legacy pipeline emits:
#   - let __slot0 = [] accumulator;
#   - function __renderSlot0(parent) {
#       for (const __entry of __slot0) parent.removeChild(__entry);
#       state.__slot0 = [];
#       for (const item of state.items) {
#         let __n0 = document.createElement("span");
#         __n0.textContent = item;
#         parent.appendChild(__n0);
#         __slot0.push(__n0);
#       }
#     }
#   - initial render: __renderSlot0(__root);
#   - click handler re-invokes __renderSlot0 after state.items mutates.
#
# NOTE: legacy currently emits <__renderSlot0> as a literal HTML tag
# instead of a placeholder div — that may be a Task 9 wiring artifact,
# but lock it down as-is to detect regressions either way.

sngl generate --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Slot accumulator + render fn.
grep '__slot0 = \[\]' out/index.html
grep 'function __renderSlot0' out/index.html

# Render fn body shape: clear old entries, then iterate state.items.
grep 'for \(const __entry of __slot0\)' out/index.html
grep 'for \(const item of state.items\)' out/index.html
grep '__n0.textContent = item' out/index.html
grep '__slot0.push\(__n0\)' out/index.html

# Initial render call at script bootstrap.
grep '__renderSlot0\(' out/index.html

# Click handler re-renders slot after mutating state.items.
grep 'state.items = state.items.push\("new"\)' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
output { none { html } }

component main {
    var items list<string> = ["a", "b", "c"]
    button(text="add", @click { items = items.push("new") })
    for item = items {
        text(value=item)
    }
}
